reviews.text: Doctor Francesco is a true, highly trained professional with passion for his work.

We discovered Dr. Assenza's practice in the middle of August, when most veterinarians had become completely unavailable.
Before meeting him, we were used to rushing from one clinic to another for every single exam. Here, however, everything we needed was there; during the visit, he performed an ultrasound, X-ray, and blood tests on-site, saving our cat from having to make multiple trips, which were very stressful for her. Unfortunately, surgery was necessary to remove some bladder stones, which I was worried about since it was the first time I'd found myself in a similar situation. But both Dr. Assenza and Dr. Marisol were impeccable, and their empathy and a touch of humor eased the tension.

But what makes the difference, beyond the purely technical aspect, is the time they dedicate to you: whether it's a phone call or a text, you can clarify any concerns thoroughly, without feeling rushed or superficial. And lastly, the Doctor isn't at all venal; on the contrary, whenever possible, he always tries to accommodate us, providing us with everything we need to continue our treatment at home with peace of mind.

We certainly hope we don't see him too often, but we know that when we need him, we'll have a new, reliable point of contact.
I had my puppy sterilized at the CEV center, by Dr. Francesco who was attentive, thoughtful and infinitely sweet! Highly recommended.

Expertise and professionalism go hand in hand with empathy and a human touch. I am forever grateful to the doctor and his team who have cared so lovingly for us and our dog Lilly since our first meeting. I wouldn't have entrusted our puppy to anyone else ♥️

I met Dr. Assenza thanks to my cousin's recommendation. Until now, I had only taken my dogs for routine vaccinations and checkups. Today, my 12-year-old Chihuahua, Ugo, underwent major surgery to remove some huge stones.

Dr. Assenza was meticulous, prompt, and explained everything to me with incredible clarity. But what really sets him apart is his great humanity. You can tell he loves animals and his work.

Ugo is doing well, and I couldn't have entrusted him to better hands. Thank you so much, Doctor. Highly recommended!

I really enjoyed my stay with a professional, competent, and above all, very attentive veterinarian. You can tell he does his job with passion and great respect for our four-legged friends.
I ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND HIM.

I came from another veterinary practice and what can I say, I was very tried and sorry for their behavior, but then I found him, Dr. Assenza, a true lover of our puppies and with a unique professionalism, he saved my French bulldog both for an ulcer in the eye and a throbbing in the ear that I could not cure elsewhere. Today I can say that my puppies have a real doctor with a unique humanity and not venal like many today. I consider myself lucky to have met him and I recommend him to everyone.
A kind person, I took my puppy to Francesco after 14 vets, he was the only one who understood the real problem, very good at his job and an exceptional person.
Dr. Francesco is an attentive, scrupulous, helpful veterinarian and you can see that he loves animals very much, I couldn't have wished for better for my cloud.

Dr. Francesco Assenza is an exceptional professional, but above all, he has a big heart that beats for each of his patients with total and exclusive love. He exudes calm and expertise at every opportunity, and even in the most difficult moments, he guides and supports you. I can never thank him enough for the care he provides for my three cats and my dog. Thank you so much ❤️

For many years, purely by vocation, I have dedicated myself to rescuing and caring for animals in the most diverse physical and emotional conditions. This life choice has led me, often against my will, to walk through the doors of countless veterinary facilities... from small provincial practices to the largest and most renowned clinics in Naples. When you constantly deal with situations of emergency and suffering, you quickly learn to recognize those who are simply practicing for a living and those who truly make a difference. What deeply impressed me about Dr. Francesco Assenza is precisely this extraordinary human and professional depth. In addition to instilling a sense of security, based on extensive experience in the field and a rigorously empirical and scientific clinical method, he demonstrates unwavering ethical integrity. His decisions are always guided by the patient's best interests, with absolute respect for their nature, ethology, and dignity.

He is a sincere professional, even when the clinical truth is unpleasant to communicate, and especially when the right path means forgoing personal gain. In a field where economic logic sometimes takes precedence, for him the true well-being of the creature he's treating is never a secondary issue.
​Dr. Assenza is a Doctor with a capital M. He's one of those rare people who seem to have been born with a doctor's coat sewn onto them, transforming his into a true life mission. Entrusting an animal to his care means having the absolute certainty that it will be protected, respected, and cared for in the best possible way.
​Thank you so much ♡.
I have never found an honest doctor like him, an honest, kind doctor, always available, treats dogs and cats like children, special, human, thank you for existing

I have a 14-year-old dog who's been treated by Dr. Francesco since he was born. I immediately felt at ease with him from the very first moment. He's humble, reliable, and humane (which is hard to find these days), and above all, he's AVAILABLE whenever I needed to call him.
What can I say? A super DOCTOR!
Doctor always available and above all very human... Highly recommended 👍
Excellent doctor
Luckily they are urgent I called this morning they didn't answer I won't express myself what you are

Through a friend, I met Dr. Assenza, who is a combination of professionalism and expertise, but what sets him apart above all is his love and respect for animals. My partner and I entrusted him with our puppy, who immediately adored him for his "cuddly" approach that makes her feel at home. For all of this, Dr. Assenza is and will remain our choice for the future of our dog.
Dr. Francesco and the other doctors represent a safe and professional place, always available and kind.
Great professionalism and competence, availability and passion make the difference

I took my beloved Totò for the first time to Dr. Francesco, a wonderful, human and above all direct person. He immediately hit the nail on the head. We hope and are confident of solving it. Thank you, doctor. We couldn't have been luckier to meet you.

Doctor Francesco is a super conscientious doctor who carries out his work with so much love and makes us pet owners feel welcomed as if we were family... I recommend him to everyone, what more can I say than 5⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

There are veterinarians who treat animals. And then there are those who also care for the people who love them. Dr. Francesco is definitely one of them.

To anyone looking for a veterinarian, I would advise them to trust someone who knows how to see the animal, not just the patient. Finding a competent professional is important, but finding someone who truly puts our pet's well-being first, who is there even when not strictly necessary, and who remembers them even years later, is something rare.

After everything he's done for my little Kelly and for us, I would choose him again. Without hesitation.

You won't regret it.

My little moon has been in trouble twice, but the doctor's helpfulness, kindness, and sweetness with my little one reassured me.

Thank you, top doctor.

We have been clients of Dr. Assenza Francesco Roberto's Veterinary Emergency Center for over 15 years.
Throughout this time, we have always found Dr. Francesco and his staff fully available to provide expert care, first for "little" Alex and, since July 2023, for Red (a 23 kg Belgian Shepherd).
We highly recommend him to everyone!
Greetings from us and a "woof" from Red.

Gaetano Andretta, Patrizia Arduink and...Red

I'm not giving zero stars because the minimum is one star. Maybe—I don't know—they're competent at treating dogs, but I can't comment on that. However, I can comment on the cats, and I can assure you of their complete incompetence and lack of empathy. If you love your cat, I strongly advise against this vet; the staff are incompetent. They'd do better to put a sign outside that says, "We don't treat cats because we're incompetent, we only treat dogs," but I have my doubts about dogs, too.

My dog ​​had an aggressive tumor. Many vets had given him up for dead, but Dr. Assenza was the only one who agreed to operate and save him. He demonstrated great professionalism, helpfulness, and kindness. Thank you again.

The doctor has always been there for us and our puppy, demonstrating great professionalism, patience, and incredible humanity. Besides being an extremely knowledgeable and experienced professional, he is someone who works with heart and always puts the animals' well-being first. He always inspires us with confidence and trust, explaining everything calmly and always making the best decision. My dog ​​and I blindly trust only him, his expertise, and his judgment because he has never made a mistake. Thank you for saving a life every day ❤️
Dr. Francesco is an honest, well-prepared and empathetic doctor, a true asset to our area!
Dr. Assenza is competent and empathetic. After my dog ​​was euthanized, he also took care of cremation at a reasonable price. Highly recommended.

Dr. Assenza is a true professional, practical yet meticulous. He managed to unravel a truly difficult situation.
I wholeheartedly recommend him for our little friends ❤️
Empathy and knowledge thank you you are wonderful

I asked
Dr. Francesco for help with a very small kitten with a neck infection.
He immediately proved to be super helpful.
He loves what he does, and he transmits it to both his sweet patients and the people who ask for help.
He tries to reassure you, put you at ease, and explains what to do and the possible solutions to keep our furry friends happy.

Highly recommended

Dr. Francesco is a serious and competent person; he solved our cat's problem.

I recommend him to everyone!
Honest, kind and very human.... A rarity these days 🤗... I highly recommend him!!!! …

I AM WONDERFUL ABOUT YOUR PROFESSIONALISM. I FULLY RECOMMEND DR. FRANCESCO ASSENZA.
I'll share my experience with you. My red-nose Pitbull inhaled a very difficult awn to remove, but with his professionalism, he managed to cure it perfectly. I FULLY RECOMMEND DR. FRANCESCO ASSENZA. HE IS VERY HELPFUL IN EVERYTHING. I DON'T KNOW HOW TO THANK HIM (he gave me a lot of confidence and made me feel very calm). THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART ❤️❤️
Thank you to Dr. Francesco for bringing my little Ponzu (Oliver) back to life and for giving dignity and hope to my other furry friends. A veterinarian with a big V. One of the few!

Dr. Francesco and his team are the best!
Reliable and kind, they cared for and helped all my furry friends. 5+ stars!
Professionalism, skill, empathy, and sensitivity have only one name: Assenza veterinary clinic!

I went to this clinic for a visit to my 7-year-old dog and I was followed in the diagnostic process from A to Z by all the staff, without ever feeling abandoned as they were always ready to give me explanations both on the phone and in person.

Congratulations to Dr. Francesco and his collaborators, thanks to them my cat is no longer here, they told me he was fine but instead he had pneumonia, that it was a female but instead it was a male, thank you, doctor of my country, congratulations, great job!
Dr. Francesco Assenza diagnosed in 10 seconds what another center couldn't diagnose in a year! Friendliness, professionalism, skill, and kindness. Trust them! :)

Introduction: We're a family of cat lovers and don't normally write reviews, but this time was different; we needed to share our positive experience.
Andrew, one of our furry rescues, had been suffering from skin sores and hair loss for some time; we suspected some sort of family conflict. When, despite preventive isolation, the situation worsened, we realized we needed to consult a professional. Through word of mouth, we ended up (not without some hesitation) at Dr. Assenza's CEV.
During Andrew's visit, however, the professionalism of Dr. Francesco and his staff immediately emerged, and so it didn't take much to reassure us. A few pleasantries also contributed to this, revealing his humanity, his non-sellability, and his love for animals, always seasoned with empathy and humor.
Our Andrew has been diagnosed with an autoimmune skin disease, and the treatment provided is working.
What can I say? Science and Conscience.
Thank you, Dr. Assenza.

Extraordinary professionalism and a huge heart: thank you for saving our little girl.
Words cannot express the gratitude we feel for Dr. Assenza. Our Penelope came to him in desperate conditions due to a severe strangulated hernia. The situation was critical, and the risk of losing her was extremely high.
In a moment of total anguish, Dr. Assenza was a beacon of light. From a medical standpoint, the surgery was performed impeccably: extraordinary precision and expertise literally saved our little girl's life. The management of her therapy and post-operative care was also impeccable, demonstrating an extraordinary level of preparation and attention to detail.
But what makes this professional truly unique is his extraordinary humanity.
With his overwhelming kindness and cheerfulness, he managed to defuse a situation that was dramatic for us. He was able to reassure and support us, keeping us from despairing in the darkest moments and instilling in us tremendous strength.
Today, our dog is back home with us, happy and recovered. Dr. Assenza didn't just cure an animal; he brought smiles back to an entire family. We recommend him to anyone looking for not only a top-notch veterinary surgeon, but also a person with rare empathy and positivity. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

I wouldn't trust my little girl to anyone other than Dr. Assenza! I only met him this year, but he's already saved my dog's life! He's an empathetic doctor, he immediately inspires trust, which is the most important thing to me. We were nervous during the surgery, but he gave us such peace of mind. He's someone who truly does it out of love for animals, a truly honest and super helpful person! The dog is now recovering, but everything is going well thanks to the professionalism and experience the doc put into the operation!! Thank you again from us 🥰😊🐶
Francesco Assenza is an experienced and dedicated veterinarian. He always treats pets with love and kindness.
I want to say thank you to Dr. Assenza who sterilized my beloved Sammy yesterday with great sensitivity, professional honesty, and psychological support. Thank you, dear Francesco, for existing.

A truly special person, not only for his great expertise but above all for his humanity and helpfulness. Even remotely, he made me feel listened to and supported in a time of concern, with clear advice and so much attention. It's rare to find professionals like him: present, empathetic, and truly ready to help. I'm sincerely grateful and highly recommend him... Dario 🩷
Veterinarian🔝 …

Dr. Francesco is a competent, conscientious veterinarian who is always attentive to both his patients and their humans. He stands out for his great listening skills and the clarity with which he explains every situation, always putting one at ease. Furthermore, he is a cheerful and humorous person, qualities that make every visit more peaceful, even during the most delicate moments. His office is equipped with numerous medical devices that allow for rapid and effective diagnoses.
I have complete trust in him and his entire team.
The vet is very attentive to our animals' care, and treats them with love. He's truly an excellent doctor, highly trained, and very professional. I recommend him to everyone.
The clinic is well-equipped and the doctor is professional, polite, and animal-loving, not venal, and always available.
Dr. Francesco is knowledgeable and very tactful with our puppies. He's a trustworthy person.
Great professionalism, experience, courtesy nothing to say Francesco very professional and above all honest best place to entrust our four-legged friends

We are patients of DOCTOR ASSENZA FRANCESCO.... a trustworthy person with great humility, he loves animals, a professional who helps even with the anxieties of us owners... my bulldog has grown and continues to grow with him... I recommend him to everyone. Loving and caring with passion, this is DOCTOR ASSENZA...

Francesco is a truly exceptional veterinarian. I've been his client for many years now, and he's become a true go-to for me. He's incredibly talented, incredibly competent, and above all, he has a unique way of caring for animals and making us, their owners, feel at ease.
He's always available, friendly, and you can tell he's passionate about his work. He's also very fair in his pricing, which is certainly not a given.
The other doctors are also excellent, kind, and highly knowledgeable.
I wholeheartedly recommend him to everyone!

I can't recommend my vet highly enough! She's extremely competent, professional, and above all, has a genuine love for animals that's evident from the very first moment. She's always made me feel at ease, explaining everything clearly and with great patience.

I trust her with both my dog ​​and my cat, and in both cases she's shown truly exceptional care and attention. She's always available, attentive, and meticulous—qualities that truly make a difference to me.

Knowing I can count on such a professional gives me peace of mind every day. Thank you so much for everything you do!
Doctor Francesco Assenza a great one saved the life of my beloved 4 legged friend what can I say an angel

I have known Doctor Assenza for 21 years, he has treated and operated on my 5 furry friends (2 ferrets, 2 cats and 1 dog). He and his staff do an excellent, professional and loving job for our 4-legged friends (which, let me tell you, is not for everyone). His is not a job but a great passion where he puts his heart and soul into it. He deserves all the respect and esteem both as a doctor and as a person, he is the best. Thank you, Dr. Francesco 😘
Yesterday my dog ​​underwent surgery by the doctor with all his clip a truly exceptional doctor gives you a lot of peace of mind and takes great care of the dog

We accompanied our little Astra, after 16 years of life together, to a better life... she was the one who decided it had to be Saturday, February 28, 2026... a day when we were all with her... and also her doctor Francesco... who was humane and sensitive towards our little girl and my son... who loves our puppy madly.... It was a delicate, important, not easy moment... but she felt the love around her... in that office... caressed and cuddled until her last breath... thank you...

Dr. Francesco Assenza was incredibly professional and immediately diagnosed my 11-year-old dog with pyometra. His experience and expertise allowed for prompt intervention and saved her life. I thank him infinitely for his dedication and care. I was impressed by the kindness and clarity with which the doctor explained the situation and the treatment options. His availability and support were crucial for me and my family during a very difficult time.
Infinite thanks to the doctor and his team, they were fantastic. My dear dog is doing great 🙏🏽☺️

"I entrusted my dog ​​to Dr. Francesco Assenza for surgery and I couldn't have made a better choice. Despite my understandable anxiety, the doctor proved to be thorough, competent, and clear in his diagnosis and post-op care. The facility was clean and the staff were competent. My dog ​​is in excellent health. A well-deserved five stars for his professionalism."

For years my little lion has been treated by Doctor Francesco, a unique professional for any problem, but yesterday he exceeded all expectations. My little one had to undergo the removal of various teeth with corresponding cleaning. The doctor carried out the work in an excellent manner, not only for Leo but also supporting us owners. He is a unique person with an enormous heart and I could not help but recommend the clinic of Doctor Francesco Assenza to all the people who, like me, care about the health of their little loves.

Dr. Francesco and his colleagues are exceptional. For a very anxious person like me, I thought it would be very difficult to face a rather delicate operation, but two days after the operation, my faithful friend is already the same as before and can't wait to see Dr. Francesco to remove the stitches and the collar. 🥇🥇🥇🥇🐕🐕🐕 …

When we arrived at the emergency room, the situation wasn't the best; we had to try everything, knowing that the chances were 30%... if not less.
But the skilled (I called them Magical 🤩) hands of Dr. Assenza made those tears shed that day turn into smiles, for me, my husband, and my boys.
A person of great professionalism
But also with a big heart ❤️.
After the surgery, he contacted us to check
on our puppy's health
and made himself available
replying to all the messages we sent
even though it was the weekend.

In addition to the doctor, I'm infinitely grateful to his assistants, empathetic, professional, and warm people who, despite the tense moments, were able to diffuse the situation with sweet words and smiles.

Thanks again from Zampa and family ❤️
Doctor super kind and affectionate towards Sole...thank you

The doctor is always kind and helpful. He truly puts the animals' well-being and the owners' peace of mind first. He explains everything clearly, without rushing, and uses humor at the right moments to ease tension while maintaining impeccable professionalism, an invaluable quality when you're worried about your pet.

The attention was wonderful. The human quality and professionalism of Dr. Francesco and his team were outstanding.

Always available, from pre-op to post-op. Any concerns or questions were addressed promptly. The sterilization went very well. Highly recommended!

An extraordinary man and doctor!

Super Super Super recommended

I've trusted Francesco and the CEV Veterinary Center for years, and I couldn't imagine a better place to care for my animals. Here, I find not only professionalism, but also genuine humanity, the kind that makes you feel listened to and supported at all times.

Francesco is always available, kind, and attentive: he understands the animals' needs and their owners' concerns, with rare patience and sensitivity. Every time I enter CEV, I feel like I'm in good hands, welcomed by people who do their job with genuine passion.

For me, CEV is more than just a veterinary clinic, but a precious reference point. I recommend it wholeheartedly.

Dr. Francesco is a person who carries out his work not only with his mind and hands but above all with his heart. A humane person and very attentive to the needs of our furry four-legged friends, you can trust him blindly.

Dr. Assenza has been
the veterinarian who treats my dogs and cats for years. He's a humane and empathetic veterinarian with his patients and their owners. His diagnostic skills have always allowed for immediate identification of the problem and initiation of appropriate treatment. Furthermore, he's an excellent surgeon and has a well-equipped facility for both diagnostics and surgery, which is not at all a given to find all this in a veterinary practice rather than a large clinic. I wouldn't trade him for any other veterinarian.

At first glance, the Veterinary Emergency Center appears to be a small clinic, but in reality, given its equipment, it's a small clinic. In addition to professionalism, expertise, and courtesy, it offers real-time assessments, which is essential in emergencies. Dr. Assenza also has incredible diagnostic skills and is extremely helpful.
He deserves an A+!

Mistaking ringworm for stress in a stray kitten, without bothering to investigate with a lamp or skin tests, is utterly rookie. Their incompetence allowed us all to be infected. I gave you one star, but you don't even deserve that.
Friendliness and professionalism are the hallmarks of this clinic. Small but highly efficient.

I only regret not having met him sooner. Not just a doctor, but a sweet, empathetic person who loves his job and animals. He was with us during a very painful time for us and was there for us, even answering calls on weekends at hours that would be difficult for others. I can only say heartfelt thanks for everything.

Five isn't enough. Finding such well-trained and compassionate professionals is hard. He's been my vet for two years now, and I wouldn't change him; my bully loves him!
Dr. Assenza is a guarantee.

My little and patient doctor Francesco has been with me for 10 years now. Not only have I found seriousness, professionalism, and "experience" over these long years, but I mean, a lot. But above all, I have found a lot of humanity: a professional who loves his job, who does it all, who loves animals so deeply that he puts his heart, soul, health, and time into it, along with his collaborators, who are also professional and experienced. I have never received rude or annoying responses. He is always available 24/7, even outside of working hours, and this shows how much professionalism there is in doing his work.
A great vet! Professional, always available, and never venal. I wouldn't change him for anything in the world!
An excellent, meticulous, empathetic, and professional veterinarian. I highly recommend him.
I found him very good, very empathetic and professional in carrying out his work❤️

Pereona is a wonderful and great professional, always available and attentive to any need, I have been going there for 15 years and I have always been satisfied, I could not have found better for my little one 🥰 …

An excellent vet, always available, a kind, humble, and very empathetic person. He has an excellent relationship with animals, is non-commercial, and very, very professional. I highly recommend him.

Super good! Dr. Francesco Assenza is incredibly competent, professional, and an exceptional diagnostician. He's passionate about his work and, above all, about his patients. For me, he's the best.

Francesco is a truly invaluable doctor... always available, affectionate, decisive, and above all, not venal like so many other vets. Furthermore, he is a man full of love for our furry friends. I highly recommend him to everyone! ♥️

Professionalism & Humanity..
My vet for 25 years 😎😎

Dr. Assenza, besides being an exceptional doctor, is always so sweet and affectionate with his furry patients. I wouldn't trade him for anyone else in the world!!!
His assistant, Dr. Maria Grazia, is also always available, kind, and competent.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ First visit exceeded all expectations!
It took just one meeting with Dr. Francesco Assenza to know that my dog ​​Karol was in excellent hands. From the first moment, he demonstrated impeccable professionalism, rare empathy, and extraordinary attention to my princess. He immediately put us at ease, explaining everything clearly and answering every question with patience and expertise.
The first visit can be a stressful moment, but thanks to him, it turned into a positive, peaceful, and reassuring experience. I couldn't have asked for anything better for Karol. Highly recommended!
Thank you so much, Doctor 💜
I can confirm that Francesco has been my trusted vet for over 20 years, very conscientious and always available, he has always saved my beloved puppies 🥰 …
Competent and kind doctor, animal lover and helpful. Ultrasounds, surgeries, emergencies: they can do everything, except CT scans and MRIs, without traveling.
Great vet, helpful and humane, I highly recommend him for your furry friends
Very good people, in addition to being incredibly professional, they also do their job with passion, they love animals and treat them with care and attention... Congratulations

There are encounters that leave a lasting impression.
People who enter your life at the most fragile moments and, with kind gestures and gentle words, manage to transform fear into trust, pain into hope.

There are doctors, and then there are people like Francesco.
He's not just an extraordinary veterinarian, he's a kind, empathetic soul, capable of tiptoeing through pain and worry, caring not only for animals but also for those who love them, in the fullest and most human sense of the word.

Our little dog underwent a very delicate procedure: a complete sterilization combined with a mastectomy of the entire mammary chain. An operation that frightened us, but in Francesco's hands, it became a journey of trust, professionalism, and love.

He welcomed us and treated us like family, with an unforgettable sweetness, with patience, attention, and always with the right word to calm us, to make us feel less alone.

He didn't just care for our dog, he also cared for us and our fearful hearts with a rare humanity.

Thank you, Doc!
For your time, for your presence, for your ability to listen and love what you do, for your immense heart, for your encompassing knowledge, for accompanying us with the sweetness of those who choose every day to be a light for others.

Our dog is doing well today, and the credit goes entirely to you.
A true professional, but above all, a person with a huge heart.

With deep respect and infinite gratitude 💛🐾
Congratulations to my doctor who greeted my cat today, she gave me a needle in the throat. Now he is very well thanks again

A friendly prankster who enjoyed teasing me about my excessive anxiety! My little one only had a routine surgery, but despite everything, Dr. Francesco was incredibly attentive! From the pre-surgery tests to small details like turning off the lights in the waiting room because it might bother the puppy! He has a love for animals and a passion for them, something doctors often lose over time! That's enough to recommend him to anyone who might have problems with their puppy, dog, cat, or whatever animal they happen to be! Thank you, Doctor...! ❤️
Dr. Francesco is a true enthusiast, with excellent expertise and professionalism.

Francesco is an exceptional doctor. Devoted to his profession! With diligence and professionalism, he cares for every animal that comes through his office as if they were his own. ❤️ Our trusted veterinarian forever.
Very good, honest, helpful people who are not at all venal.
Excellent facility and exceptional staff 👍👍👍 …

I brought my dog ​​with very shortness of breath due to a pulmonary embolism... Dr. Francesco was very direct, empathetic, and helpful. He prescribed the treatment and is monitoring her himself. Highly recommended.

On Friday afternoon, I took my kitten, who had been vomiting for 10 days, to Dr. Assenza for an ultrasound (as prescribed by the vet). The doctor, however, performed a fast ultrasound, assuring the vet that no foreign body was evident and that it was severe gastritis (even though he had only told me it could be inflammation). On Sunday evening, I had to have emergency surgery on my kitten (at another clinic) because he had a rubber band stuck in his throat. The ultrasound would have shown that his intestines were twisted, and perhaps I could have intervened sooner. He was my first pet, and I didn't realize he hadn't performed an ultrasound but a fast ultrasound. I arrived at the office twenty minutes before closing time, and it might have been late for the requested test, but he could have told me instead of doing another one. Mistakes are human, and I don't question the doctor's competence and skill, but he was superficial and unprofessional in my kitten's case. Obviously, everyone has their own experience, positive or negative, and I'm not blaming the doctor, but I think feedback could be helpful.
